nodes.name: Sklearn Ensemble Forest Predict-Preflight Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic helpers for the pure-Python preflight inside BaseForest._validate_X_predict: missing-value validation mode selection and the CSR sparse-index dtype guard.

nodes.name: forest_predict_ensure_all_finite_mode
nodes.description: Choose sklearn's ensure_all_finite validation mode for forest prediction based on whether the fitted tree supports missing values.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

nodes.name: forest_predict_require_sparse_int32_indices
nodes.description: Enforce sklearn's rejection of CSR sparse matrices whose indices or indptr arrays are not stored with np.intc dtype before forest prediction.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Inference on N samples down the decision tree paths of average depth log N takes O(N log N) time and linear space for results.
